name: Pi Harness Review 2026: Pricing, Extensions, and Alternatives
description: The current public project is the earendil-works/pi monorepo. Its README describes the project as the home of the Pi agent harness and lists the interactive coding agent CLI, agent runtime, unified multi-provider LLM API, and terminal UI library as first-class packages.
